messages:
Marina: PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5123 — schema bundle reorg + compact examples for function/tool calling. Two asks: spot JSON schema typo and patch broken anchor docs/faq#tool-calling. Trying to land today.

Devin: running jsonschema-cli now, will report errors.

schema-lint-bot: [auto] validate ./docs/structured-output/example.json -> ERROR: line 24: unexpected token ',' (trailing comma)

Sam: I can update SDK snippets (py/ts) to match new envelope shape. Marina, do we prefer compact envelope or full fields?

Marina: compact envelope. Suggested schema snippet: {"type":"object","properties":{"envelope":{"type":"object","properties":{"tool":{"type":"string"},"output":{"type":"object"}},"required":["tool","output"]}},"required":["envelope"]} — drop into file.

Devin: fixed trailing comma on line 24 and committed. re-running validator.

schema-lint-bot: [auto] re-run -> OK: no schema errors.

Jess: patched anchor to docs/tooling/calling#examples and added a redirect. linkcheck passed locally.

Sam: opened tiny PR to update client.invoke(..., response_format="envelope") in python snippet.

Marina: final checklist: update linked snippet PRs, add CHANGELOG docs migration note, run staging smoke deploy. Who will run smoke?

Sam: I'll kick off staging after my snippet PR merges.

Devin: merged schema fix (commit 0f3a1b). CI green so far.

Marina: thanks all — will merge after staging smoke is green. Leaving thread open for late finds.
